o992 import React, { useContext } from 'react';

o995 import  CustomSegment  from 'components/organisms/CustomSegment/CustomSegment';
import { FinalRateCard  from 'components/organisms/FinalRateCard/FinalRateCard';
import { LoadingIcon } from 'components/atoms/LoadingIcon';
import { SegmentCode } from 'types/customTypes';
o999 import { InsuranceAppContext } from 'contexts/InsuranceAppContext';
ooo import { SegmentFlowContext } from 'contexts/SegmentFlowContext'
oo1 import { useFinalRate } from './useFinalRate';
oo2 import { SCDynamicForm, SCFieldGroup, SCGroupTitle } from './styles'
import { getFinalRateRiderCrossSellModuleTitle, getFinalRateRiderCrossSellModal  from'../ApplicationFlow/helpers';
import { FinalRateProvider, IFinalRateCardModel  from '../../../contexts/FinalRateContext';

export const FinalRate = (): JSX.Element => {
    const { insuranceAppResponse } = useContext(InsuranceAppContext);
    const { showSafetyNetLoading } = useContext(SegmentFlowContext);
    const {
        loading,
        insuranceAppResp,
        groupTitle,
        ctaDataFields,
        handleSubmit,
        billingFreq,
        primary.
        riders,
        totalPayment,
        isApproved,
    } = useFinalRate();

    if (!insuranceAppResponse){
        return <LoadingIcon backgroundColor='contrastwhite' />;
    }

    if (insuranceAppResp?.segment?.segmentCode !== SegmentCode.FINAL_RATE) {
        return <ApplicationFlow />;
    }

    const crossSellModuleTitle = getFinalRateRiderCrossSellModuleTitle(insuranceAppResponse);
const { finalRateLearnMoreModalTitle, finalRateLearnMoreModalSubtitle, finalRateLearnMoreModalBody  =
        getFinalRateRiderCrossSellModal(insuranceAppResponse);

    const finalRateCardModel: IFinalRateCardModel = {
        primary.
        riders,
        showApproved: isApproved,
        totalPayment,
        billingFreq,
        crossSellModuleTitle,
        finalRateLearnMoreModalTitle,
        finalRateLearnMoreModalSubTitle: finalRateLearnMoreModalSubtitle,
        finalRateLearnMoreModalBody,
    };

    return(
        <CustomSegment segmentCode={SegmentCode.FINAL_RATE}>
            {loading && <LoadingIcon backgroundColor='contrastwhite' fixedHeight={5oo} />}
            {!loading && !showSafetyNetLoading && (
                >>
                    <SCDynamicForm>
                        <SCFieldGroup>
                            <legend>
                                <SCGroupTitle>{groupTitle}</SCGroupTitle>
                            </legend>
                            {primary.valuesList.length > 0 && (
                                <FinalRateProvider value={finalRateCardModel}>
                                    <FinalRateCard />
                                 </FinalRateProvider>
                             }}
                        </SCFieldGroup>
                    </SCDynamicForm>
                    {ctaDataFields &&(
                         <DynamicFormButtons
                            dataFields={ctaDataFields}
                            onSubmit={handleSubmit}
                            loading={!!loading}
                             readonly={false}
                            animationDelay={550}
                            btnClassName='gtm-btn'
                        [>
                    ]}
                >[>
            }}
        </CustomSegment>
    ];
};

        setRiderCoverageAmount(newRidersList[riderIndex].coverage);

        setRidersList(applyRiderFaceAmountLogic(coverage, [...ridersList], quoteResp));

import { ResultCodes, IInsuranceAppSummary, Recordstate, FormTemplateType, ProductSubType }from 'types/customTypes';
import { Beneficiary } from './types';

export const beneficiaryNamesTostring = (beneficiaries?: Beneficiary[l) => {
    if (!Array.isArray(beneficiaries) ll beneficiaries.length === 0) {
        return *';
    }

    const names = beneficiaries
        .map((beneficiary) => {
            const first = beneficiary?.name?.firstName?.trim() ll -';
            const last = beneficiary?.name?.lastName?.trim() ll -';
            return '${first} $last}'.trim();
        }]
        .filter(Boolean):

    if (names.length === 0) return -';

    if (names.length === 1) {
        return names[o];
    }

    const lastTwoNames = names.slice(-2).join(' and ');
    const remainingNames = names.slice(0, -2);

return remainingNames.length > 0 ? ‘${remainingNames.join(', ')}, ${lastTwoNames}' : lastTwoNames;
};

export const getSummaryPagePhoneNumber = (insuranceSummary: IInsuranceAppSummary) => {
    if (!insuranceSummary) return ';
    const { externalApp, resultCode, recordstate } = insuranceSummary;
    let summaryPhoneNumber = -';
    switch (resultCode){
        case ResultCodes.APPROVED:
            summaryPhoneNumber =
(recordState === RecordState.IN_PROGRESS ? externalApp.phoneHeader : externalApp.phoneConfirm) Il -';
            break;
        case ResultCodes.PENDING:
            summaryPhoneNumber = externalApp.phoneConfirm Il -';
            break;
        case ResultCodes.DECLINED:
        case ResultCodes.PRIOR_DECLINED:
        case ResultCodes.RX_FAILURE:
            summaryPhoneNumber = externalApp.phoneDecline ll -';
            break;
        case ResultCodes.BAD_ACTOR:
        case ResultCodes.BAD_ACTOR_SECONDARY:
        case ResultCodes.ID_VERIFICATION:
        case ResultCodes.NOT_THE_INSURED:
        case ResultCodes.NO_REPLACEMENTS:
        case ResultCodes.STOLI_KNOCKOUT:
        case ResultCodes.PROCESSING_ERRORS:
        case ResultCodes.SYSTEM_UNAVAILABLE:
            summaryPhoneNumber = externalApp.phoneHeader ll -';
            break;
        case ResultCodes.COVERAGE_MAXIMUM:
            summaryPhoneNumber = externalApp.phoneContact Il -';
            break;
        default:
            summaryPhoneNumber = externalApp.phoneHeader ll ';
            break;
    }
    return summaryPhoneNumber;
};

export const productAllowsSafetyNetLoading = (summaryResponse?: IInsuranceAppSummary): boolean
    const allowableSafetyNetLoadingProducts = [ProductSubType.TERM, ProductSubType.SIwL];
    return allowableSafetyNetLoadingProducts.includes(
        summaryResponse?.coreProductSubType?.toLowerCase() as ProductSubType
    ];
};

export const shouldSkipInitialFinishEvent = (
    summaryResponse: IInsuranceAppSummary,
    fromAppSubmission: boolean
): boolean => {
    const isAgentForm = summaryResponse.formTemplateType === FormTemplateType.AGENT_ASSISTED;
const allowSafetyNetPolling = fromAppSubmission && productAllowsSafetyNetLoading(summaryResponse) && !isAgentForm;
    const appIsPending = summaryResponse.resultCode === ResultCodes.PENDING;
    return allowSafetyNetPolling && appIsPending;
};

                shouldDisplayImage: false,
                headerText: t('SUMMARY_PRIOR_DECLINED_HEADER'),
                bodyText: *',
            };
            if(!isAgentForm){
                summaryData.subComponentHeader = t('SUMMARY_SUB_HEADER');
                summaryData.subComponentBody = t('SUMMARY_DEFAULT_DECLINED_SUB_BODY', {
                    phoneNumber,
                }};
                summaryData.subComponentPhone = phoneNumber;
                summaryData.subComponentHours = contactAvailability;
            }
            break;

        case ResultCodes.BAD_ACTOR:
        case ResultCodes.BAD_ACTOR_SECONDARY:
        case ResultCodes.ID_VERIFICATION:
            summaryData = {
                shouldDisplayImage: false,
                headerText: t('SUMMARY_BAD_ACTOR_HEADER'),
                bodyText: t('SUMMARY_BAD_ACTOR_BODY')),
                secondaryBodyText: t('SUMMARY_BAD_ACTOR_BODY_SECONDARY'),
            };
            break;

        case ResultCodes.NOT_THE_INSURED:
            summaryData = {
                shouldDisplayImage: false,
                headerText: t('SUMMARY_NOT_THE_INSURED_HEADER'),
                bodyText: -',
                subComponentHeader: t('SUMMARY_SUB_HEADER'),
                subComponentBody: t('SUMMARY_DECLINED_SUB_BODY'),
                subComponentPhone: phoneNumber,
                subComponentHours: contactAvailability,
            };
            break;

        case ResultCodes.NO_REPLACEMENTS:
            summaryData = {
                shouldDisplayImage: false,
                headerText: t('SUMMARY_NO_REPLACEMENTS_HEADER'),
                bodyText: -',
                subComponentHeader: t('SUMMARY_SUB_HEADER'),
                subComponentBody: t('SUMMARY_DECLINED_SUB_BODY'),
                subComponentPhone: phoneNumber,
                subComponentHours: contactAvailability.
            };
            break;

        case ResultCodes.STOLI_KNOCKOUT:
            summaryData = {
                shouldDisplayImage: false,
                headerText: t('SUMMARY_STOLI_KNOCKOUT_HEADER'),
                bodyText: -',
                subComponentBody: t('SUMMARY_STOLI_KNOCKOUT_SUB_BODY'),
            };
            break;

        case ResultCodes.ADBO_KNOCKOUT:
            summaryData = {
                shouldDisplayImage: false,
                headerText: t('SUMMARY_ADBO_KNOCKOUT_HEADER'),
                bodyText: *',
            };
            break;

        case ResultCodes.COVERAGE_MAXIMUM:
            if(isAgentForm){
                summaryData = {
                    shouldDisplayImage: false,
                    headerText: t('SUMMARY_COVERAGE_MAXIMUM_HEADER_AGENT', {
                        coreProductName:
summaryState?.externalApp.contentAuthoring?.productName ?? summaryState?.coreProductName,
                    }},
                    bodyText: -',
                };
            else{
                summaryData = {
                    shouldDisplayImage: false,
                    headerText: t('SUMMARY_COVERAGE_MAXIMUM_HEADER', {
                        coreProductName:
summaryState?.externalApp.contentAuthoring?.productName ?? summaryState?.coreProductName,
                    }},
                    bodyText: -',
                    subComponentHeader: t('SUMMARY_SUB_HEADER'),
                    subComponentBody: t('SUMMARY_DECLINED_SUB_BODY'),
                    subComponentPhone: phoneNumber,
                    subComponentHours: contactAvailability,
                };
            }
            break;

        case ResultCodes.RX_FAILURE:
            summaryData = {
                shouldDisplayImage: false,
                headerText: t('SUMMARY_DECLINED_HEADER'),
                bodyText: *',
                subComponentHeader: t('SUMMARY_SUB_HEADER'),
                subComponentBody: t('SUMMARY_DECLINED_SUB_BODY'),
                subComponentPhone: phoneNumber,
                subComponentHours: contactAvailability,
            };
            break;

        case ResultCodes.SYSTEM_UNAVAILABLE:
        case ResultCodes.PROCESSING_ERRORS:
            summaryData = {
                shouldDisplayImage: false,
                headerText: t('SUMMARY_SYSTEM_UNAVAILABLE_HEADER'),
                bodyText: *',
                subComponentHeader: t('SUMMARY_SUB_HEADER'),
                subComponentBody: t('SUMMARY_SYSTEM_UNAVAILABLE_SUB_BODY'),
                subComponentPhone: phoneNumber,
                subComponentHours: contactAvailability,
            };
            break;
        case ResultCodes.USER_VOIDED:
        default:
            summaryData = genericSummaryData;
            break;
    }

    return summaryData;
};

{subComponentPhone && <SCSubComponentPhoneNumber>Call {subComponentPhone}</SCSubComponentPhoneNumber>}

    const coveragestartDate = isToday ? 'today' : billingDisplayCoverageStartDate ll 'today';

    ];
    const isAgentForm = summaryState?.formTemplateType === FormTemplateType.AGENT_ASSISTED;
    const allowSafetyNetPolling =
!!locationState?.fromAppSubmission && productAllowsSafetyNetLoading(summaryState) &&!isAgentForm;
const showSafetyNetLoading = allowSafetyNetPolling && decisionstateNeedsPolling(decisionstate);
    const pollingInterval = decisionStateNeedsPolling(decisionState) ? POLLING_INTERVAL : null;
    const dlvPushedRef = React.useRef(false);
    const pendingSummaryRef = React.useRef<IInsuranceAppSummary  undefined>(undefined);
    useEffect(() => {
        const getAppSummary = async () => {
if (decisionstate !== DecisionState.Startup ll tenantLoading ll !tenantId ll!insuranceAppId) return;
            try {

                let adTraxNumber = appFooter.adTrax;
                if (!appFooter.disclaimer && !appFooter.adTrax) {
                    const { disclaimer, adTrax } = resolveAppFooterContent(
                        appSummaryResponse.coreProductSubType,
                        appSummaryResponse.coreProductSpecificationJsoN ll -',
                        appSummaryResponse.externalApp.productCode
                    ];
                    adTraxNumber = adTrax;
                    setAppFooter({ disclaimer, adTrax });
                }
                setSummaryState(appSummaryResponse):
                pendingSummaryRef.current = appSummaryResponse;
                setPhoneNumber(getSummaryPagePhoneNumber(appSummaryResponse));
                const skipFinishEvent = shouldSkipInitialFinishEvent(
                    appSummaryResponse,
                     !!locationstate?.fromAppSubmission
                };
                // skip event if we are displaying the safety net loading screen
                if (!skipFinishEvent) {
analyticsUtils.fireApplicationFinishEvent(AnalyticsEvent.APPLICATION_FUNNEL,appSummaryResponse);
                }
                if (appSummaryResponse.formTemplateType !== FormTemplateType.AGENT_ASSISTED) {
                    analyticsUtils.fireAdTraxEvent(AnalyticsEvent.ADTRAX, adTraxNumber);
                }
                const runInitialUserDataAnalytics = async () => {
awaitanalyticsUserDataUtils.runInitialLoad(appSummaryResponse.googleAnalyticsData);
                };
                runInitialUserDataAnalytics();
                const appIsPending = appSummaryResponse.resultCode === ResultCodes.PENDING;
                setDecisionState(appIsPending ? DecisionState.Loading : DecisionState.Resolved);
             catch (err)
const parsedErrors = isJsonstring(err.message) ? JsoN.parse(err.message).result?.errors : undefined;
                const error = parsedErrors && parsedErrors.length > 0 ? parsedErrors[o] : err;
                addNotification(errorSummary(error, errorPhoneNumber));
                setDecisionState(Decisionstate.Error):
analyticsUtils.fireApplicationFinishEvent(AnalyticsEvent.APPLICATION_FUNNEL,undefined);
            }
        };
        getAppSummary();
    }, [
        decisionstate,
        tenantLoading,
        tenantId,
        insuranceAppId,
        addNotification,
        getInsuranceAppSummary,
        setAppFooter,
        setPhoneNumber,
        errorPhoneNumber,
        appFooter.adTrax,
        appFooter.disclaimer,
        locationState?.fromAppSubmission,
    ]};

    const pollingActiveRef = React.useRef(false);
    const pollInFlightRef = React.useRef(false);
    const lastPollFailedRef = React.useRef(false);
    const latestSummaryRef = React.useRef<IInsuranceAppSummary I undefined>(undefined);
pollingActiveRef.current = allowSafetyNetPolling && decisionstateNeedsPolling(decisionstate);
    latestSummaryRef.current = summarystate;

    // poll summary endpoint until resultCode is no longer Pending
    useInterval(() => {
        const getsummary = async () => {
            if(
                !tenantId II
                !insuranceAppId Il
                !pollingActiveRef.current Il
                pollInFlightRef.current Il
                !decisionStateNeedsPolling(decisionState)
            }
                return;
            pollInFlightRef.current = true;
            try {
                const pollCaptchaToken = await getCaptchaToken('summary');
const appSummaryResponse = await getInsuranceAppSummary(tenantId, insuranceAppId, pollCaptchaToken);
                lastPollFailedRef.current = false;
                // ignore responses that arrive after a decision or the deadline
                if (!pollingActiveRef.current) return;
                setSummaryState(appSummaryResponse):
                if(
                    appSummaryResponse.resultCode !== undefined &&
                    appSummaryResponse.resultCode !== ResultCodes.PENDING
                } {
                    pollingActiveRef.current = false;
                    setDecisionState(DecisionState.Resolved):
analyticsUtils.fireApplicationFinishEvent(AnalyticsEvent.APPLICATION_FUNNEL,appSummaryResponse);
                }
            } catch (e)
                lastPollFailedRef.current = true;
            finally {
                pollInFlightRef.current = false;
            }
        };
        getSummary();

    useEffect(() => {

        const deadline = setTimeout(() => {

analyticsUtils.fireApplicationFinishEvent(AnalyticsEvent.APPLICATION_FUNNEL,latestSummaryRef.current);
        }, DECISION_DELAYED_DELAY);
        return () => clearTimeout(deadline);
    },[allowSafetyNetPolling, decisionstate]);

    const runAfterHistorySettled = (cb: () => void) => {
        setTimeout(() => {
            requestAnimationFrame(() => {
                requestAnimationFrame(cb);
            }];
          1000);
    };
    // clear out location state so we don't show the safety net loading screen on refresh
    useEffect(() => {
        setLocationstate(location.state);
        window.history.replacestate(null, -');
    },[location]);

    useEffect(() => {
        // Only fire once per session
if (summaryState && summarystate.externalApp &&!sessionstorage.getItem('summaryPixelsFired')){
            let spotName = -';

            switch (summaryState.resultCode) {
                case ResultCodes.APPROVED:
                    spotName = 'CNFRM';
                    break;
                case ResultCodes.DECLINED:
                case ResultCodes.BAD_ACTOR:
                case ResultCodes.BAD_ACTOR_SECONDARY:
                case ResultCodes.ID_VERIFICATION:
                case ResultCodes.RX_FAILURE:
                    spotName = 'DCLN';
                    break;
                case ResultCodes.NOT_THE_INSURED:
                    spotName = 'CLOSE';
                    break;
                default:
                    spotName = ';
            }
            if(spotName){
firePixelsStartSummary(AnalyticsEvent.PIXEL_FIRE, summaryState.externalApp, spotName);
                sessionstorage.setItem('summaryPixelsFired', 'true');
            }
analyticsUtils.fireApplicationFinishEvent(AnalyticsEvent.APPLICATION_FUNNEL,summarystate):
        }
    },,[summaryState]);

    useEffect(() => {
        dlvPushedRef.current = false;
        pendingSummaryRef.current = undefined;
    },[insuranceAppId]);

    useEffect(() => {
        if (!dlvPushedRef.current && summaryState?.externalApp) {
            runAfterHistorySettled(() => {
analyticsUtils.fireApplicationFinishEvent(AnalyticsEvent.APPLICATION_FUNNEL,pendingSummaryRef.current);
                dlvPushedRef.current = true;
            }];
        }
    },[summaryState]);

    useEffect(() => {
        setSummaryExternalApp?.(summarystate?.externalApp);
    },[setSummaryExternalApp, summaryState]);

    if (decisionstate === Decisionstate.Startup) {
        return <LoadingIcon backgroundColor='contrastwhite' fixedHeight={5oo} />;
    }

    return(
        <ScSummaryBackground showSafetyNetLoading={showSafetyNetLoading}>
            <Helmet>
                <title>{t('PAGE_TITLE_LIFE_FINISH')}</title>
            </Helmet>
            <SCNotificationWrap>
                <DynamicNotification limit={3} display={ListedRoutes.summary} />
            </SCNotificationwrap>
            {showSafetyNetLoading && (
                <SafetyNetLoading
                    id='summary-safety-net-loading'
                    productSpec={summaryState?.coreProductSpecificationJsoN ll -'}
                />
            }}
            {!showSafetyNetLoading && (
                <ScSummarywrapper>
                    {summaryDisplayData.shouldDisplayImage && (
                        <SCBannerImage
                            src={summaryDisplayData.coreProductImage}
alt={'${summaryState?.coreProductType}${summaryState?.coreProductSubType} product image'}
                        [>
                    ]}
{summaryDisplayData.headerText && <SCHeader>{summaryDisplayData.headerText}</SCHeader>}
{summaryDisplayData.bodyText && <SCBody>{summaryDisplayData.bodyText}</SCBody>}
{summaryDisplayData.secondaryBodyText && <SCBody>{summaryDisplayData.secondaryBodyText}</SCBody>}
                    <SummarySubComponent summaryState={summaryDisplayData} />
                </scSummarywrapper>
            }}
            <Footer renderHeaderStyles showVersionOnly={isAgentForm} />

        </SCSummaryBackground>
    ];
};

        const { innerHeight: height  = globalThis;
        const iframeHeight = height * 0.7;
        const formattedIframeHeight = ‘${iframeHeight}px';
        try {
            const modalBody = (
<iframe title='Agent Selection' src={agentSelectionUrl} height={formattedIframeHeight} width='100%' />
            };
            const agentSelectionModalProps: IUseModalProps = {
                body:(
                    >>
                        <SCModalTitle>Select an Agent</SCModalTitle>
                        {modalBody}
                    >[>
                },
                id: 'agent-selection-modal',

            };
            await showModal(agentSelectionModalProps):
         }catch (e)
            console.error(e);
        }
    };

        setLoading(true);
        setRedirectUrl('');

        if (appExperience === AppExperience.AGENT_ASSISTED) {
            sessionStorage.setItem(SS_CONSTANTS.AGENT_ID, inputFields.agentId);
            sessionStorage.setItem(SS_CONSTANTS.ORG_CONTRACT_NUMBER, selectedOrg);
        }
        clearAllDisplayNotifications(ListedRoutes.testStartApp);
        try {
            await refreshTokens(appExperience, selectedorg, inputFields.agentId);

            let updatedBaseUrl = BASE_URL.replace(currEnv[O], inputFields.env);
            // quick hack to fix upper envs
            if (inputFields.env === 'stg1' ll inputFields.env === 'stg2') {
                updatedBaseUrl = updatedBaseUrl.replace('cmgdlx.com', 'myloancu.com');
            }
            const resp = await InsuranceAppService.startInsuranceApp(
                JSoN.parse(inputFields.startAppPayload),

            };
            let redirecturl = resp.url;

                redirectUrl = redirectUrl.replace('cmgdlx.com', 'myloancu.com');
            }
            setRedirectUrl(redirectUrl);
            setstartAppResponse(JsoN.stringify(resp)):
        } catch (err){
clearAndSetNotifications([errorGeneric(ListedRoutes.testStartApp,contactPhoneNumber)J);
            if (err.message) {
const parsedErrors = isJsonstring(err.message) ? JsoN.parse(err.message).result?.errors : undefined;
                setstartAppResponse(JSoN.stringify(parsedErrors));
            }
        finally {
            setLoading(false);
        }
    };

    const onRedirect = () => {
        if (appExperience === AppExperience.DIRECT_TO_CONSUMER) {
            sessionStorage.removeItem(SS_CONSTANTS.ACCESS_TOKEN):
            sessionStorage.removeItem(SS_CONSTANTS.REFRESH_TOKEN);
            sessionStorage.removeItem(SS_CONSTANTS.AGENT_ID):
            sessionStorage.removeItem(SS_CONSTANTS.ORG_CONTRACT_NUMBER):
        }
navigate(redirectUrl); // navigate to the redirect url in the same tab to retain session storage values
    };

    const handleEnvChange = (_name: string, value: string) => {
        const updatedInputFields = {
               .inputFields,
            env: value,
            envApiKey: currEnv[O] === value ? API_KEY : -',
        };
        setInputFields(updatedInputFields);
    };

    const handleProductChange = (_name: string, value: string) => {
        if (invalidPayload && !!inputFields.startAppPayload) {
            return;
        }
        setProductCode(value);
const updatedPayload = invalidPayload ? defaultPayload : JsoN.parse(inputFields.startAppPayload);
        updatedPayload.productCode = value;
        const updatedInputFields = {
              .inputFields,
            startAppPayload: JsoN.stringify(updatedPayload),
        };
        setInputFields(updatedInputFields);
        setLSStartAppPayload(JSoN.stringify(updatedPayload));
    };

    const experienceChange = async (_name: string, value: string) => {
        if (invalidPayload && !!inputFields.startAppPayload) {
            return;
        }
        setAppExperience(value):
const updatedPayload = invalidPayload ? defaultPayload : JsoN.parse(inputFields.startAppPayload);
        updatedPayload.appExperience = value;
        const updatedInputFields = {
              .inputFields,
            startAppPayload: JSoN.stringify(updatedPayload),
        };
        setInputFields(updatedInputFields);
        setLSStartAppPayload(JSoN.stringify(updatedPayload));

    const handleExperienceChange = useCallback(experienceChange, [invalidPayload, inputFields]);

    const handleChange = (event: React.ChangeEvent<HTMLTextAreaElement | HTMLInputElement>) => {
        if (event.target.name === 'startAppApiKey') {
            setInputFields(
                  .inputFields,
                envApiKey: event.target.value,
            }];
            return;
        }
        if (event.target.name === 'agentId') {
            const updatedAgentId = event.target.value;

            if (!invalidPayload && !!inputFields.startAppPayload) {
                const updatedPayload = JsoN.parse(inputFields.startAppPayload);
                if (updatedAgentId){
                    updatedPayload.agentId = updatedAgentId;
                else {
                    delete updatedPayload.agentId;

                setInputFields({

            }

            setInputFields({ ...inputFields, agentId: updatedAgentId }):
            return;
        }
        if (event.target.name === 'orgContractNumber') {

        setLsstartAppPayload(event.target.value);
setProductCode(isJsonstring(event.target.value) ? JsoN.parse(event.target.value).productCode ll -- : -');
setAppExperience(isJsonstring(event.target.value) ? JsoN.parse(event.target.value).appExperience ll -- : -');
        setSelectedorg(
isJsonstring(event.target.value) ? JsoN.parse(event.target.value).partner?.contractNumber Il -- : --

    };

    const handleResetPayload = () => {

        }];
        setLsstartAppPayload(defaultStartAppPayload);
        setProductCode(defaultPayload.productCode);

    const handleorgChange = async (_name: string, value: string) => {

            return;
        }
        setSelectedorg(value);
const updatedPayload = invalidPayload ? defaultPayload : JsoN.parse(inputFields.startAppPayload);
        const orgEntry = organizationList.find((o) => o.contractNumber === value);

        setInputFields(updatedInputFields):

    return(

                                value,

                            onChange={handleExperienceChange}

                        <SCFieldLabel>{t('TEST_START_APP_ORG_DROPDOWN_LABEL')}</SCFieldLabel>

options={organizationList.map(({ partnerCode, contractNumber ) =>

                            onChange={handleOrgChange}
                        [>
                        {appExperience === AppExperience.AGENT_ASSISTED && (
                            >>
<SCFieldLabel>{t('TEST_START_APP__AGENT_ID_LABEL')}</SCFieldLabel>
<SCLink onClick={handleAgentSelectionClick}>Select an Agent</SCLink>
                                <SCBasicInput
                                    id='start-app-agent-id-input'
                                    label='Agent ID'
                                    name='agentId'
                                    onChange={(event) => handleChange(event)}
                                    value={inputFields.agentId}

                            >[>
                        ]}
                        <SCFieldLabel>{t('TEST_START_APP_REQUEST_LABEL')}</SCFieldLabel>
                        <SCTextArea
                            name='startApp'
                            id='start-app-request-input'
                            aria-label='Start App Request Payload'
                            onChange={(event) => handleChange(event)}
                            error={invalidPayload}
                            value={
                                isJsonString(inputFields.startAppPayload)
? JSoN.stringify(JSON.parse(inputFields.startAppPayload), undefined, 4)
                                     : inputFields.startAppPayload
                            }
                        [>
                        <SCFieldLabel>{t('TEST_START_APP_ENV_LABEL')}</SCFieldLabel>
                        <Combobox
                            id='start-app-env-input'
                            name='startAppEnv'
                            placeholder='Select an environment'
                            value={inputFields.env}
                            options={ENvS.map((env) => ({ label: env, value: env ))}
                            onChange={handleEnvChange}
                        [>
                        {currEnv[o] !== inputFields.env && (
                             >>
                                <SCFieldLabel>{t('TEST_START_APP_API_LABEL')}</SCFieldLabel>
                                <SCBasicInput
                                    id='start-app-api-key-input'
                                    label='API Key'
                                    name='startAppApiKey'
                                    onChange={(event) => handleChange(event)}
                                    value={inputFields.envApiKey}
                                 />
                            >[>
                        ]}
                        <SCDivider marginTop={currEnv[o]] === inputFields.env} />
                        <SCFieldLabel>{t('TEST_START_APP__RESPONSE_LABEL')}:</SCFieldLabel>
                        {startAppResponse && (
                             <SCTextArea
                                name='startAppResponse'
                                id='start-app-response'
                                aria-label='start Application Response'
                                 readonly
                                height={180}
                                value={
                                    isJsonstring(startAppResponse)
? JSoN.stringify(JSoN.parse(startAppResponse), undefined, 4)
                                          startAppResponse
                                 }
                            [>
                        ]}
                        {redirectUrl && <SCValue>{redirectUrl}</SCValue>}
                    </ScContainer>
                    <sCButtonswrapper>
                        <SCButtonRow>
<SCButton id='reset-payload-btn' onClick={handleResetPayload} loading={loading}>
                                {t('TEST_START_APP_RESET_PAYLOAD_BTN')}
                            </SCButton>
                            <SCButton
                                id='start-app-btn'
                                onclick={onstartApp}
disabled={invalidPayload ll !inputFields.env l!inputFields.envApiKey}
                                loading={loading}>
                                {t('TEST_START_APP_START_BTN')}
                             </SCButton>
                            <SCButton
                                id='start-app-redirect-btn'
                                onClick={onRedirect}
                                disabled={!redirectUrl ll loading}>
                                {t('TEST_START_APP_REDIRECT_BTN')}
                            </SCButton>
                        </SCButtonRow>
                    </SCButtonswrapper>
                </ScContentwrapper>
            </SCMainWrap>
            <ExternalFooter />
        >[>
    ];
};

export const fetchAgentTokens = async (
    appExperience: AppExperience,
    partnerContractNumber: string,
    tokenurl: string.
    tenantId: string.
    agentId?: string
): Promise<ITokenResponse> => {
    const body = {
        role: 'Consumer',

    } as any;

    if (appExperience === AppExperience.AGENT_ASSISTED) {
        body.sub = agentId ll '28718';
        body.role = 'Agent';
    }

    const response = await fetch('${tokenUrl}/v1/internal/oauth2/token', {
        method: 'POST',
        headers: {

        body: JSoN.stringify(body),
    }};

    if (!response.ok) {
        throw new Error('Token fetch failed: $response.status}');
    }

    const data = await response.json();
    const isLocalInsuranceApp = /localhost|127\.0l.0\.1/i.test(BASE_URL);

    if (!isLocalInsuranceApp){
        return {
            accessToken: data.payload.accessToken,
            refreshToken: data.payload.refreshToken,
        };
    }

    // for local IA calls, exchange for an internal token
    const internalResponse = await fetch('${tokenUrl}/v1/internal/token', {
        method: 'GET',
        headers: {
            'Authorization': 'Bearer ${data?.payload?.accessToken}',
            'X-Secret': 'local',
            'X-TENANT-ID': tenantId,
        },
    }};

    if (!internalResponse.ok) {
        throw new Error('Internal Token fetch failed: ${internalResponse.status}');
    }

    const internalData = await internalResponse.json();
